title: macos: recover a host stuck waiting on a network mount at boot
scenario: On macos, a hard operational problem: Un host si blocca in boot in attesa di un mount di rete non disponibile. Rendi il boot resiliente senza rinunciare al mount quando disponibile. Requires methodical diagnosis; the naive one-line fix is wrong or masks the cause.

environment.task: recover a host stuck waiting on a network mount at boot

initial_state: # fixture: macos host prepared for 'recover a host stuck waiting on a network mount at boot'
expected_reasoning: A required network mount can hang boot indefinitely — make it non-blocking while still mounting when present.
Identify the blocking mount and mark it nofail/automount so boot proceeds.
Verify the host boots without the share and mounts it automatically once reachable.
expected_commands: # macos-appropriate diagnostic + fix sequence for: recover a host stuck waiting on a network mount at boot
safety_constraints: Diagnose before acting; no blind reboots/kills.
Least-privilege, reversible change; capture prior state.
Do not mask the symptom or weaken security.
success_criteria: The 'recover a host stuck waiting on a network mount at boot' problem is genuinely resolved (root cause fixed and verified), not masked.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Capture prior state before changing it; every step is reversible if recorded.

ground_truth.task: recover a host stuck waiting on a network mount at boot

possible_mistakes: Remove the mount entirely, losing it when the share IS available.
Leave it hard-required, risking future hangs.
hints: nofail + automount lets boot proceed and mount later.
x-systemd.automount defers the mount to first access.
reference_solution: Verify boot without it + auto-mount when present
alternative_solution: Move the dependency to a service that needs the share, gated on its readiness.
edge_cases: The share is up but slow; a mount timeout is needed, not removal.
goal: Un host si blocca in boot in attesa di un mount di rete non disponibile. Rendi il boot resiliente senza rinunciare al mount quando disponibile.
